We evaluate DoLa on two multiple choice text completion tasks: TruthfulQA (Lin et al., 2022) and FACTOR (Muhlgay et al., 2024).
datasets: Word-pair datasets from Hendel et al. and Todd et al.
outputs: Generated text for completions and translations
The outputs consist of token probabilities and predicted tokens in multiple-choice settings, where the model selects the most likely completion.
